SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_task_instance ti LEFT JOIN sys_task t ON ti.task_id = t.id WHERE ti.completed = 0 AND CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' ', IFNULL(t.deadline_time, '18:00:00')) < NOW()

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_task_instance ti LEFT JOIN sys_task t ON ti.task_id = t.id WHERE ti.completed = 0 AND YEARWEEK(DATE(CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' ', IFNULL(t.deadline_time, '18:00:00'))), 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_task_instance WHERE YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_task_instance WHERE completed = 1 AND YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_task_instance WHERE completed = 1 AND on_time = 1 AND YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_task_instance WHERE completed = 1 AND on_time = 0 AND YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_task_instance WHERE completed = 0 AND YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)

SELECT i.id, i.description, i.severity, i.status, p.name as projectName FROM sys_issue i LEFT JOIN sys_project p ON i.project_id = p.id ORDER BY i.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT r.id, r.description, r.level, r.status, p.name as projectName FROM sys_risk r LEFT JOIN sys_project p ON r.project_id = p.id WHERE r.status != '已消除' ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, name, customer, pm_name as pmName, stage, progress, status FROM sys_project WHERE status = '进行中' ORDER BY update_time DESC
